items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: then I would learn rag time piano from Frank Eubanks, who learned it from Jelly Roll

ctx.x: I played house parties and all of that, just for my own pleasure and then I would learn rag time piano from Frank Eubanks, who learned it from Jelly Roll, and then he would teach me these rags, you know, and I would play house parties --
Jelly Roll had spent quite a bit of time in --
